# HoBo

> HoBo is an AI-native meta-cloud, currently in the design phase: a cloud-agnostic control
> plane and durable runtime that maps one application description (a "Bindle") onto any mix
> of real providers. The programmable surface is WIT/WASM (Component Model / wasmCloud);
> TypeScript is the first reference implementation. Agents are first-class principals with
> scoped credentials, an MCP control surface, and a replayable event log for every action.
> The product is NOT shipped: this repository is an active design suite plus executable
> proof/contract packages and a production package scaffold.

Key facts:

- One deploy verb: `hobo up` realizes the object graph (build, plan, gate, provision, deploy); `hobo down` reverses it.
- Concepts: Bindle (app topology) ⊂ Camp (provider target + durable runtime) ⊂ Yard (provider control plane) ⊂ Junction (cross-Yard federation).
- Everything is event-sourced and replayable, including agent token issuance.
- Providers, IaC engines (Pulumi/Crossplane/OpenTofu), and build tools sit behind WIT ports with conformance-gated adapters, ideally AI-generated.
- This repo is wired for coding agents (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Copilot CLI): read AGENTS.md before editing.
